correctness.rationale: Two equal singular values per partition cell follow by an explicit rank-two adjoint calculation even for complex multipliers. Uniform piecewise C1 variance gives smooth scale h^(p-1) with coefficient 2*12^(-p/2); a jump contributes a two-level variance profile |Delta| sqrt(theta(1-theta))+O(h), and uniform phase averaging yields the beta integral. Balancing scales proves p<1, p=1, p>1 with exact constants and all boundary cases. Finite tests include independent matrix SVD and the exact sawtooth finite-N Hilbert-Schmidt formula; analytic reasoning, not finite tests, proves the limits.

value.rationale: The measurable critical trace combines two fundamentally different mechanisms: smooth variation and finite interface discontinuities. It canonically corrects complete jump suppression from aligned deterministic grids and quantifies the three-regime spectral cost with sharp constants across all p>0. This is a natural structural classification in local projection approximation, rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
